info.title: Objects API
info.description:
The Objects API is a service that manages the storage and distribution of arbitrary binary _objects_ across your Lattice environment.
Objects consist of the file data and metadata that describes the object.

Use objects to let your assets upload and access binary files across the environment
for use-cases such as storing mission-critical text files, or thumbnails.

For more information, see [Objects](https://developer.anduril.com/guides/objects/overview).

server.description: The Lattice server instance to connect to.

tags.name: Objects
tags.description: API to manipulate and interrogate object data on the local node, as well as list objects from the Lattice mesh.

get.description: Lists objects in your environment. You can define a prefix to list a subset of your objects. If you do not set a prefix, Lattice returns all available objects. By default this endpoint will list local objects only.

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: Filters the objects based on the specified prefix path. If no path is specified, all objects are returned.

parameters.name: sinceTimestamp
parameters.description: Sets the age for the oldest objects to query across the environment.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: Base64 and URL-encoded cursor returned by the service to continue paging.

parameters.name: allObjectsInMesh
parameters.description: Lists objects across all environment nodes in a Lattice Mesh.

parameters.name: maxPageSize
parameters.description: Sets the maximum number of items that should be returned on a single page.

get.description: Fetches an object from your environment using the objectPath path parameter.

parameters.name: objectPath
parameters.description: The path of the object to fetch.

parameters.name: Accept-Encoding
parameters.description: If set, Lattice will compress the response using the specified compression method. If the header is not defined, or the compression method is set to `identity`, no compression will be applied to the response.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description: Indicates a client's preference for the priority of the response. The value is a structured header as defined in RFC 9218. If you do not set the header, Lattice uses the default priority set for the environment. Incremental delivery directives are not supported and will be ignored.

Content-Encoding.description: The compression used on the response body.

post.description: Uploads an object. The object must be 1 GiB or smaller.

parameters.name: objectPath
parameters.description: Path of the Object that is to be uploaded.

parameters.name: Time-To-Live
parameters.description: An optional expiry TTL associated with an object. The value represents the number of nanoseconds the object will exist in the local store. If no TTL is supplied, the server applies a default TTL. In most cases, the default TTL is 90 days. However, it might be higher or lower, depending on the retention requirements of your environment.

parameters.name: Content-Length
parameters.description: Size of the object to upload in bytes.

parameters.name: Distribution-Mode
parameters.description: Controls how the object is distributed across the mesh. If set to `force`, the object will be force distributed to all nodes. Force-distributed objects are subject to a size limit.

delete.description: Deletes an object from your environment given the objectPath path parameter.

parameters.name: objectPath
parameters.description: The path of the object to delete.

head.description: Returns metadata for a specified object path. Use this to fetch metadata such as object size (size_bytes), its expiry time (expiry_time), or its latest update timestamp (last_updated_at).

parameters.name: objectPath
parameters.description: The path of the object to query.

NotFound.description: The specified resource was not found

path.description:
A valid path must not contain the following:
- Spaces or Tabs
- Special characters other than underscore (_), dash (-), period (.) and slash (/)
- Non-ASCII characters such as accents or symbols
Paths must not start with a leading space.

checksum.description: The SHA-256 checksum of this object.
